feature_contract.goal: Deliver one fully usable F11 settings shell in Quest3/VDXR and desktop, with correct atlas density, responsive bounds, keyboard/gamepad/mouse editing, focus handoff and durable settings persistence.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: F11 ImGui overlay and its font/input/INI lifecycle only. Gameplay HUD, ESC/pause/menu aspect, world stereo and SkyGlow remain untouched.
trace_stages: F11 original Win32 input bound action and OverlayWindow settings slider from OverlaySettingsWindow
ImGui frame text glyph atlas producer and DX9Ex backbuffer DrawData scoped as External ScreenOverlay2D
R30 per-eye optical positioning of F11 independent from gameplay HudScale and XR full-eye font atlas density
Overlay.ini persistence, Next EndScene invalidation and Reset/reopen desktop/menu fallback
subcomponents: Native-eye VR readable font atlas and proportional F11 shell/control bounds across 4:3,16:9,21:9 and Reset
Mouse/keyboard/gamepad edit commit through focus, tab switch, close and ONCE-per-edit disk persistence
Valid saved font scale reload including corrupt/nonfinite INI fallback and stereo semantic isolation

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Live F11 font density and full-screen shell follow source/eye aspect; keyboard/gamepad and mouse edits reconstruct atlas with controls still usable
Editing font with keyboard/pad, dragging and changing tabs or closing F11 saves once without losing value or writing every mouse frame
Nonfinite INI values, invalid source extent, desktop mode, resolution changes and closed F11 never break font atlas/layout or game sprite HUD
Final DX9Ex Active Win32 host/game/full-chain/package and Domain Isolation pass same SHA; source impact passes material SHA or final SHA as applicable

diagnosis.original_evidence: User reported Quest3 F11 illegibly small at 3440x1440 mirror with 2496x2688 per-eye, and full F11 font/controls/persistence acceptance remains untested on headset.
source_trace: OverlaySettingsWindow::draw_appearance() used a mouse release only commit to set FontsDirty and settingsDirty; keyboard/gamepad and tab handoff are not mouse releases
Overlay::render_shell() correctly classifies external F11 and scales shell; Overlay::render() previously lacked global finalisation when Overlay tab disappeared
D3DEndScene rebuild_fonts() and ImGui_ImplDX9_InvalidateDeviceObjects() rely on FontsDirty to rasterise the new font, then external ScreenOverlay2D semantic routes to R30 per-eye optical composition
diagnosis.root_cause: Mouse-only slider finalisation stranded keyboard/gamepad and focus/tab/close changes without font atlas rebuild or durable Overlay.ini save; an arbitrary invalid saved float could pass through std::clamp to floor() and ImGui TTF.
alternatives_rejected: F11 external ScreenOverlay2D already bypasses gameplay HudScale, so changing HUD or per-eye world projection is not the cause of keyboard save failure
XR F11 atlas density and normalized shell layout already have tests; simply raising raster font size cannot trigger a missing keyboard release/save event
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The F11 ImGui DX9 draw is external ScreenOverlay2D, shared source bitmap passed through per-eye R30 correction; keyboard/INI font persistence is independent from stereo world and gameplay HUD.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Frame-owned FontScalePending and FontScaleCommitRequested finalise after tab rendering, including tab-switch and close, once after editing; INI read and final scale are finite-guarded; next EndScene rebuilds DX9 font texture.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing F11 density/projection/reset negatives plus added keyboard/pad/drag/tab/close/nonfinite INI numeric and six destructive mutations; final CI still pending.
